# smak

Scalable Model Averaging Kiot.  Implements the [scalable frequentist model averaging](dx.doi.org/10.1080/07350015.2022.2116442)
approach to linear regression of Zhu _et al._, 2022.


-- Steven E. Pav, shabbychef@gmail.com

## Installation

This package may be installed from CRAN; the latest version may be
found on [github](https://www.github.com/shabbychef/smak "smak")
via devtools:

```{r install,eval=FALSE,echo=TRUE}
if (require(devtools)) {
	# latest greatest
	install_github('shabbychef/smak')
}
```

# Basic Usage

## Replicating Figure 1

```{r tryit,eval=FALSE,echo=TRUE}
require(smak)
require(mvtnorm)
require(magrittr)
require(dplyr)

dosim <- function(nobs, R2, npred=5, rho=0.6, nsim=1000, errors=c('homoscedastic', 'heteroscedastic')) {
	errors <- match.arg(errors)
	R <- rho^(toeplitz(1:npred) - 1)
	theta <- runif(npred, min=0, max=2)
	results <- replicate(nsim,{
		X <- rmvnorm(nobs, sigma=R)
		mu <- X %*% theta
		bit <- mean((mu - mean(mu))^2)
		sigs2 <- bit * ((1/R2) - 1)
		epsi <- switch(errors,
				homoscedastic={ rnorm(nobs, sd=sqrt(sigs2)) },
				heteroscedastic={ rnorm(nobs, sd=sqrt(ifelse(seq_len(nobs) %% 2 > 0,3,1) * sigs2)) }
		)
		y <- mu + epsi
		est_smma <- smamfit(y, X, method='mallows', return.X=FALSE, return.fitted=TRUE)
		est_sjma <- smamfit(y, X, method='jackknife', return.X=FALSE, return.fitted=TRUE)
		est_full <- lm.fit(X, y)
		# I think the scoring is on each i?
		loss_smma <- sum((est_smma$fitted.values - mu)^2)
		loss_sjma <- sum((est_sjma$fitted.values - mu)^2)
		loss_full <- sum((est_full$fitted.values - mu)^2)
		c(smma=loss_smma, sjma=loss_sjma, full=loss_full)
	}) %>% 
		t() %>%
		data.frame() %>%
		summarize(smma=mean(smma),sjma=mean(sjma),full=mean(full))
}
# dosim(100, 0.2) -> oop
dosim(500, 0.1) -> oop
dosim(500, 0.5) -> oop

set.seed(1234)
resu <- tidyr::crossing(tibble(R2=seq(0.1,0.9,by=0.1)),
												tibble(errors=c('heteroscedastic','homoscedastic')),
												tibble(ssize=c(50, 100, 500))) %>%
	group_by(R2, errors, ssize) %>%
		summarize(output=list(dosim(nobs=ssize, R2=R2, errors=errors, nsim=100))) %>%
	ungroup() %>%
	tidyr::unnest(output)

resu %>%
	mutate(smma=smma/full, sjma=sjma/full) %>%
	select(-full) %>%
	tidyr::gather(key=estimator,value=relative_loss,smma,sjma) %>%
	ggplot(aes(R2, relative_loss, linetype=estimator)) + 
	geom_line() + 
	geom_hline(yintercept=1,linetype='dotted',alpha=0.1) +
	scale_y_sqrt() + 
	facet_wrap(errors ~ ssize)
	
```
